-- Klaert die verbleibenden Ueberbuchungen, die Inklusive-Mengen,
-- die Dubletten und die Testtermine. Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT
        p.booking_id,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
        coalesce(p.quantity, 0)   AS menge,
        coalesce(p.amount_net, 0) AS betrag
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT
        b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status,
        coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
        sum(pos.menge) AS menge_summe,
        bool_or(pos.kat = 'Inklusive' OR pos.kat ~ 'weitere[ns]? Person') AS ist_paket,
        string_agg(
            concat(left(pos.kat, 30), ' x', pos.menge, ' @', round(pos.betrag, 2)),
            ' + ' ORDER BY pos.betrag DESC, pos.kat
        ) AS zeilen_text
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4
),
mit_plaetzen AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           CASE WHEN j.ist_paket THEN greatest(j.menge_summe, 1) ELSE 1 END AS plaetze
    FROM je_buchung j
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT
        o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum, o.offerdef_ref, o.offer_number,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht')                    AS buchungen,
        coalesce(sum(m.plaetze) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht'), 0) AS plaetze,
        round(coalesce(sum(m.netto) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN mit_plaetzen m ON m.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum, o.offerdef_ref, o.offer_number
),
ueber AS (
    SELECT * FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND plaetze > user_maximum AND buchungen > 0
),
dubletten AS (
    SELECT o.name, o.date_start, count(*) AS saetze,
           string_agg(o.offer_number, ' / ' ORDER BY o.offer_number) AS nummern
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND o.date_start IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY o.name, o.date_start
    HAVING count(*) > 1
),
roh AS (
    -- A. Positionszeilen der Buchungen auf ueberbuchten Terminen
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Zeilen Ueberbuchung' AS bereich,
           concat(to_char(u.date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(u.name, 24),
                  ' b', right(m.booking_id::text, 5)) AS kennzahl,
           m.plaetze::numeric AS wert,
           left(m.zeilen_text, 170) AS hinweis
    FROM ueber u
    JOIN mit_plaetzen m ON m.offer_id = u.offer_id AND m.status = 'gebucht'

    -- B. Inklusive-Menge gegen den Rest der Buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Inklusive Muster',
           concat('inklusive x', i.menge),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze im schnitt ', round(avg(m.plaetze), 2),
                  ' / netto im schnitt ', round(avg(m.netto), 2),
                  ' / hoechste plaetze ', max(m.plaetze))
    FROM mit_plaetzen m
    JOIN pos i ON i.booking_id = m.booking_id AND i.kat = 'Inklusive'
    WHERE m.status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3

    -- C. Dubletten einzeln
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Dublette',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(name, 34)),
           saetze::numeric,
           left(nummern, 120)
    FROM dubletten

    -- D. Verdaechtige Termine
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Verdaechtig',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(name, 34)),
           user_maximum::numeric,
           concat('buchungen ', buchungen, ' / plaetze ', plaetze,
                  ' / netto ', netto, ' / nummer ', left(coalesce(offer_number, '-'), 26))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 60 OR date_start >= '2027-01-01'

    -- E. Kursgruppen ab 2023, die groessten nach Netto
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Kursgruppe ab 2023',
           left(coalesce(min(name), 'ohne name'), 40),
           round(sum(netto), 2),
           concat('termine ', count(*),
                  ' / plaetze ', sum(plaetze),
                  ' / auslastung ', round(avg(plaetze::numeric / user_maximum) * 100, 1),
                  ' / gruppe ', left(coalesce(offerdef_ref, '-'), 12))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start >= '2023-01-01' AND user_maximum > 0 AND user_maximum <= 60
          AND buchungen > 0 AND offerdef_ref IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY offerdef_ref
    HAVING sum(netto) >= 4000
)
SELECT
    'S36' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')),
                  coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;
